Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul && python3 - <<'PY'
import json, pathlib
trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"src/p_lx_elf.cpp","function":"PackLinuxElf64::unpack","line":7154,"var":"overlay_offset","code":"fi->seek(overlay_offset - sizeof(l_info), SEEK_SET); fi->readx(&linfo, sizeof(linfo));","note":"Attacker-controlled packed ELF drives unpack() to read the loader metadata from the overlay region."},
  {"step":2,"file":"src/p_lx_elf.cpp","function":"PackLinuxElf64::unpack","line":7178,"var":"ph.c_len","code":"fi->readx(&bhdr, szb_info); ph.u_len = get_te32(&bhdr.sz_unc); ph.c_len = get_te32(&bhdr.sz_cpr);","note":"The compressed ELF header/segment blob length is taken from file data and used to size the in-memory buffer."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src/p_lx_elf.cpp","function":"PackLinuxElf64::unpack","line":7208,"var":"u_phnum","code":"u_phnum = get_te16(&ehdr->e_phnum); if ((umin64(MAX_ELF_HDR_64, ph.u_len) - sizeof(Elf64_Ehdr))/sizeof(Elf64_Phdr) < u_phnum) throwCantUnpack(...);","note":"The unpacked ELF header supplies the program-header count, and the check only constrains it by the total header size budget."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src/p_lx_elf.cpp","function":"PackLinuxElf64::unpack","line":7210,"var":"o_elfhdrs","code":"o_elfhdrs.alloc(sizeof(Elf64_Ehdr) + u_phnum * sizeof(Elf64_Phdr)); memcpy(o_elfhdrs, ehdr, o_elfhdrs.getSize());","note":"The unpacked header and program headers are copied into a heap buffer whose layout is later walked as an array of Elf64_Phdr records."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src/p_lx_elf.cpp","function":"PackLinuxElf64::unpack","line":7214,"var":"phdr","code":"phdr = (Elf64_Phdr *) (void *) (1+ ehdr); for (unsigned j=0; j < u_phnum; ++phdr, ++j)","note":"Iteration begins at the first program header immediately after the ELF header, so any malformed header layout is consumed directly from attacker data."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src/p_lx_elf.cpp","function":"PackLinuxElf64::unpack","line":7216,"var":"filesz / offset","code":"unsigned const filesz = get_te64(&phdr->p_filesz); unsigned const offset = get_te64(&phdr->p_offset);","note":"Each program header field is decoded as a 64-bit little-endian value; malformed header bytes can steer later seeks and reads."},
  {"step":7,"file":"src/bele_policy.h","function":"LEPolicy::get64","line":173,"var":"p","code":"V upx_uint64_t get64(const void *p) C { return get_le64(p); }","note":"The little-endian policy forwards the read to the raw 64-bit accessor without adding bounds checks."},
  {"step":8,"file":"src/bele.h","function":"get_le64","line":222,"var":"p","code":"inline upx_uint64_t get_le64(const XE64 *p) noexcept { return ne64_to_le64(get_ne64(p)); }","note":"The accessor performs an 8-byte load from the supplied pointer, so if the pointer is past the end of the allocated MemBuffer the read overflows the heap buffer."}
]
pathlib.Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json').write_text(json.dumps(trace, separators=(',',':')))
print('wrote trace')
